derivation: (3,0) goes to 2, but (2,0) is unstable. (4,0) goes to 3, and (4,1) goes to 2, both unstable targets. That is FT004, so §9.1 rejects the table.

Why the precondition exists: under the classical definitions without §9.1, {1,3},{1,2,4} is a closed cover of this table. Settling its reduced reset in column 0 alternates between the two classes forever.
